title: End To End Testing Refactor
description: Implement the end-to-end testing refactor plan: make the nearest language-neutral domain owner the unit of test ownership. Deliver a new repo test domain (🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/🧪️test) owning taxonomy, Gherkin feature parsing, case discovery, scenario planning, oracle registry, native host protocols, result schemas, semantic comparison profiles, reporting, test-output cleanup and multi-ecosystem test dependency classification. Add Nx per-test-case project generation from **/🧪️tests/*/component.feature, native hosts for TypeScript/Rust/Go/Python/.NET, oracle-first development protocol, PDF pilots (pdf-writer creation oracle, lopdf editing oracle) on the ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🗿️artifacts/📄️pdf owner, safe `clean test`, taxonomy/testing policy breach families, multi-ecosystem dependency baseline with production reachability, CI gates, and launch.json entries. compose/** is a hard forbidden path for discovery, migration, cleaning, coverage and reports.
summary:
WAVE 2 — Phase 6 owner migration with real oracles, plus the §13 non-aggregate metrics. (Wave 1 built the platform: testing domain, 5 native hosts, Nx per-case projects, clean/dependency/CI/launch wiring — see 📋️architecture.md and 📊️verification.txt.)

MIGRATED TWO REAL OWNERS, FULL LIFECYCLE. 🏷️class-name-composition: split honestly into a flattening half with `clsx` as a genuine oracle (4 @mode-differential scenarios, 4/4 parity) and a conflict-resolution half over repository-owned utility families where no library is a valid oracle — `tailwind-merge` was available and would have "worked" while proving nothing, so it is a recorded no-oracle decision backed by specification vectors (3 @mode-conformance scenarios). 🏷️style-variants: `class-variance-authority` is a genuine oracle because styleVariants() re-implements its published contract; 3/3 differential parity across base-only, the full single-variant matrix including the explicit null opt-out, boolean choices and compound conjunctions. Both legacy 🧪️component.test.ts files deleted together with their ⚛️react vitest include entries; migration baseline lowered 50 → 48.

§13 NON-AGGREGATE METRICS. computeCoverageMetrics/enforceMetricGates/formatMetrics deliver scenario coverage, per-implementation coverage, per-implementation parity coverage, oracle coverage, dependency-clean coverage, and per-implementation line/branch source coverage read from each language's own report — an implementation that reported nothing is a GAP, never silently 100%, so a blended percentage can no longer stand in for an untested language. New `metrics` command, `test metrics [--enforce]` root route, Nx targets, launch entries, and CI steps (informational on affected scope, enforcing in test-exhaustive).

VERIFIED: 6 cases across 4 owners, 32 executions all passing, 37/37 parity comparisons equal, 39 platform self-tests (554 assertions), contract clean, typecheck clean, dependency gate clean at 208 entries with 4 registered oracles (pdf-writer, lopdf, clsx, cva) all productionReachable:false and the production-reachable count held at 154 across both additions. Generated Nx case targets run green.

THREE REAL BUGS FOUND AND FIXED. (a) Root `test <phase> <level>` silently ran the WRONG level — TestScript resolved the level from segments[0], which is the phase word, so `test parity quick` ran at fundamental, executed 5 of 7 scenarios and reported a pass; the new metrics gate caught it. Level is now resolved over the segments following the phase, and both argument orders produce the identical 7/7 run. (b) The oracle-purity scan produced false positives on any narrowed run — its exclusion set came from the caller's selected cases, so `contract --case X`, which is exactly what every generated Nx case target runs, reported every other case's adapter as production source importing an oracle; the exclusion is now derived from a full repository discovery inside the scan. (c) The no-oracle rule demanded two implementations for every recorded decision, including conformance cases resting on specification vectors — a rule those decisions never claimed to meet; the requirement now follows each decision's declared substitutes, and a @mode-differential scenario with neither an oracle nor a second implementation is caught at contract time. All three are covered by regression self-tests.

STILL BLOCKED, NOT BY THIS WORK: the PDF pilot's subject phase. semio-framework-os-kernel fails with 179 errors — 162 `semio_framework_job::` references in 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🏪️store/🦀️component.rs with no such dependency in the os-kernel manifest, introduced by commit 9d7cabfd9c from a concurrent session. It fails in any workspace. The metrics gate names the gap precisely (scenario coverage 13/18, rust implementation coverage 3/8) rather than hiding it; both PDF cases go green as soon as that manifest edge lands.

Records: 📋️contract.md, 📋️architecture.md, 📊️verification.txt (wave 1), 📊️verification-wave2.txt (this wave, including the migration playbook), 📋️status.md (owner ladder, dashboard, deliberate deviations).
